source_content: These are ONLY three separate sword animation layers,NOT characters. First and second cells show the source golden yellow blade,guard and all small brown/yellow grip fragments. The third cell is ONLY the very narrow golden sword fragment exactly as shown,with its little bent cap and small side projection. It is NOT a complete sword. Do not extend,straighten,complete or invent hidden parts. No added hand,body,full blade,sparkles,stars,trails,particles or outlines. Keep every authentic small source part,including disconnected little brown grip pixels. This proxy is12x for inspecting tiny sources;the final engine artwork will be placed at4x by whole-image resampling.
